snippets.bike: The bike: road bike with a yellow frame and fork (#FBE122), black handlebar tape, black saddle. Both wheels identical and WITHOUT spokes: a thick black tyre, a yellow rim ring inside it, a solid cream (#FFFDF5) inner disc and a small black hub dot in the center. No spokes, no spoke lines.
snippets.runner: For running the character wears no helmet: a yellow (#FBE122) sweatband around the head instead, the yellow jersey as a running shirt, black shorts and black running shoes with cream soles. No bike.
snippets.team: The team: several copies of the same character, every one exactly the reference character design (same face, fur, helmet and jersey), in slightly different poses and expressions.
snippets.coins: Coins: plain gold (#C99A2E) discs with a black outline and a thin cream inner ring, no symbols, letters or faces on them.

badges.scene: The character riding a road bike, side view, rolling along happily and holding one hand up proudly as if waving to a crowd. A small gold milestone stone at the roadside. {{bike}}

The character riding a road bike with a small black saddle bag and a water bottle, side view, a big round gold sun rising behind, determined grin, a few black motion lines behind the rear wheel. {{bike}}

The character riding a road bike, side view, between two tiny landmarks: the wavy-roofed Elbphilharmonie concert hall behind him on the left and the Eiffel Tower ahead on the right, both small and simple in black outline with cream and gold fills. Wide-eyed and amazed at how far he got. {{bike}}

The character riding a road bike through a desert, side view, a small cream neck flap hanging from the back of his helmet against the sun. Two tall cream sand dunes behind, a cactus cheering him on with its arms up, a single sweat drop. Cheeky and unstoppable. {{bike}}

The character riding a road bike on top of a small round globe, like riding around the planet. Continents in gold, oceans in light blue, black outlines. Arms raised in triumph while riding, huge grin. {{bike}}

The character pushing his road bike up the last steep bit of a rounded hill, then standing on the top with one foot on the pedal, a small gold flag planted on the summit, proud and a bit out of breath, one sweat drop. {{bike}}

The character riding a road bike up a steep mountain road with tight hairpin bends drawn in cream on a gold mountain, side view near the top, a cream snow cap on the peak, puffed cheeks, tongue out with effort. {{bike}}

The character on the snowy summit of a very high, pointy mountain, holding his road bike above his head with both hands, a small gold flag next to him, clouds below the summit in cream. Ecstatic, mouth wide open in a cheer. {{bike}}

The character riding a road bike over the rounded top of a giant crater volcano on another planet, ground in fur orange with small craters, a few small cream stars and a gold ringed planet in the sky above. Wearing a round cream space helmet bubble over the yellow cycling helmet, delighted and giggling. {{bike}}
The character standing next to his road bike giving an enthusiastic high five to a second character (the same character design), both grinning, a small gold burst where their hands meet. {{bike}}

The character at a coffee stop during a group ride: sitting at a tiny round table with a cream coffee cup in one hand and a slice of cake on a plate, his road bike leaning against the table, laughing at a joke. {{bike}}

The character riding a road bike in the middle of a short paceline of three riders (all the same character design), front view slightly from the side, giving a thumbs up towards the viewer, everyone smiling. {{bike}} {{team}}

The character standing proudly with a black captain's armband with a gold star on his upper arm, one foot on his road bike's pedal, chest puffed out, a whistle on a black cord around his neck. Cheeky, knowing smile. {{bike}}
The character doing a slow, wobbly track stand on his road bike between three small gold traffic cones, arms out for balance, tongue poking out in concentration, one tiny sweat drop. {{bike}}

The character slaloming smoothly through a row of small gold traffic cones on his road bike, leaning into the curve like a pro, relaxed half-closed eyes and a cool smirk, curved black motion lines tracing his path. {{bike}}
The character holding up a single shiny gold coin with both hands, staring at it with huge sparkling eyes and an open-mouthed 'wow', a few small gold sparkles around the coin. {{coins}}
The character sitting cross-legged next to a neat little stack of gold coins, carefully adding one more coin on top with the tip of his tongue out in concentration. {{coins}}
The character hugging a round gold piggy bank that is full to bursting, a coin popping out of the slot, the character grinning slyly. {{coins}}
The character standing next to a pyramid of gold coins as tall as himself, one hand proudly on the pyramid, the other giving a thumbs up, big confident grin. {{coins}}
The character pushing a black wheelbarrow overflowing with gold coins, leaning into it, cheeks puffed, a few coins bouncing out over the edge. {{coins}}
The character diving head first into a big heap of gold coins like into a swimming pool, legs and tail sticking up, coins splashing up around him. {{coins}}

The character lifting a giant gold coin as big as himself above his head like a weightlifter, knees bent, face scrunched up with effort but grinning, a few small motion lines showing it wobbling. {{coins}}

The character standing with arms wide open and face turned up, laughing, while gold coins rain down from above around him, a small black umbrella forgotten upside down at his feet filling with coins. {{coins}}
The character sitting on top of a tall, slightly wobbly tower of gold coins that reaches into a few cream clouds, legs dangling, eating a banana, totally relaxed. {{coins}}
The character as a king: lounging on a throne made of stacked gold coins, a small gold crown balanced on top of his yellow helmet, holding a banana like a scepter, smug and delighted. {{coins}}
The character jogging happily, side view, mid-stride with both feet off the ground, arms swinging, a little puff of dust behind the back foot. {{runner}}
The character running in a race with a blank cream race bib pinned to his shirt (no number on it), side view, focused face, steady stride, three short black motion lines behind him. {{runner}}

The character running past a cheering spot, grabbing a cream paper cup from a small table while running, water splashing out in light blue, cheeky grin, a blank cream race bib on his shirt. {{runner}}

The character breaking through a cream finish-line tape with both arms raised high, a gold laurel wreath around his head, mouth wide open in a victory shout, the tape flying apart, small gold stars bursting around him. {{runner}}
The character lacing up a pair of brand new black running shoes, sitting on the ground, one shoe on and one in hand, excited eager face, small gold sparkles on the shiny new shoes. {{runner}}
The character jogging through rain and jumping into a puddle, light blue splash flying up, light blue raindrops falling, laughing with joy instead of minding the weather. {{runner}}

The character jogging at sunrise with black headphones over the sweatband, eyes closed, head bobbing to the beat, a small black music note floating behind him, a big round gold sun low behind. {{runner}}
The character running along a river bank with small light blue waves, a black harbour crane in the background, side view, relaxed and smiling, one hand waving to the viewer. {{runner}}
The character trail running down a rocky hill, leaping from one gold rock to the next, arms out, grinning wildly, a few pebbles flying. {{runner}}
The character sitting on the ground, proudly holding up a completely worn-out black running shoe with holes in the sole, his toes poking out of the other shoe, laughing at it. {{runner}}
Three characters standing around a small heap of gold coins, each tossing one more coin onto it, all cheering. {{team}} {{coins}}
Three characters building a coin pyramid together: two holding the base steady, one standing on their shoulders placing the top coin, all concentrating, tongues out. {{team}} {{coins}}
Four characters carrying a giant gold coin together on their shoulders like a log, marching in step, one of them counting out loud with an open mouth, the others grinning. {{team}} {{coins}}
Four characters jumping into a big pool of gold coins at the same time, mid-air, holding hands, coins splashing everywhere, all screaming with joy. {{team}} {{coins}}

Four characters in a small black rowing boat floating on a sea of gold coins, rowing with oars, one of them at the front looking ahead through a black telescope. {{team}} {{coins}}
Five characters lifting one of them high in the air in celebration, the one on top holding up a gold trophy cup filled with gold coins, coins flying, everyone cheering wildly. {{team}} {{coins}}
Three characters riding road bikes in a line on a road, side view, close together, the front one pointing ahead, all smiling. {{team}} {{bike}}

Four characters riding road bikes past a tall signpost with several blank gold arrow signs pointing in all directions (no text on them), side view, everyone looking up at it curiously. {{team}} {{bike}}
Four characters riding road bikes along the top of a long winding wall with small square battlements over gold hills, side view, waving. {{team}} {{bike}}
Four characters riding road bikes in a line over the top of a small round globe, continents in gold and oceans in light blue, the riders halfway round, all grinning. {{team}} {{bike}}

Five characters riding road bikes in a circle all the way around a small round globe, continents in gold and oceans in light blue, a black dashed line showing they have already gone round more than once. {{team}} {{bike}}

Five characters riding road bikes along a gold ring orbiting a small round globe like a planet's ring, the globe with gold continents and light blue oceans, small cream stars around, everyone cheering. {{team}} {{bike}}

Three characters in the black basket of a big round cream balloon, rising high above cream clouds, the characters leaning over the edge of the basket and looking down, amazed. {{team}}

Three characters floating weightless in space with their road bikes, upside down and laughing, a simple cream space station with gold solar panels behind them, small cream stars around. {{team}} {{bike}}
Three characters jogging together side by side, side view, chatting and laughing while running. {{team}} {{runner}}
A relay race: one character handing a gold baton to the next character while both run, the next one reaching back with a determined grin. {{team}} {{runner}}
Four characters running along a river bank with small light blue waves and a black harbour crane behind, a small seagull flying alongside, everyone smiling. {{team}} {{runner}}
Four characters running up a mountain trail in a line, the leader at the top turning back and reaching a hand down to pull the next one up. {{team}} {{runner}}
Five characters running across the top of a small round globe, continents in gold and oceans in light blue, holding hands in a chain, all laughing. {{team}} {{runner}}
Five characters riding road bikes in a tight little group, slightly from the front, all grinning at the viewer. {{team}} {{bike}}

A huge crowd of characters on road bikes seen from above, riding in a formation that makes a big heart shape on a cream road, all looking up and waving. {{team}} {{bike}}
